biography.plain_text: Marvin R. Crone is an American charitable foundation officer associated with Deerfield, Illinois. He serves as president and treasurer of the Cole-Crone Family Foundation alongside his wife, Julie Cole Crone, and fellow director Sophie Crone. Through Julie, he is the son-in-law of Jerome Cole, co-founder of the scientific and laboratory equipment business Cole-Parmer.

long_biography.plain_text:
Marvin Crone's work in family philanthropy predates the Cole-Crone name. He served as vice president, treasurer and director when the organisation was still the Jerome and Ilene Cole Foundation in 2007, with Ilene as president. He later became president himself, continuing to combine that office with responsibility as treasurer.

The foundation makes grants to selected charitable organisations rather than accepting unsolicited applications. Its giving has included unrestricted support for Endeavor Health, the Rush Endowed Scholarship Fund and Northern Illinois Food Bank. It has also made unrestricted grants to Direct Relief, which supplies medical aid, and World Central Kitchen, which provides meals during emergencies.
